notes:
LTTH Version 1.4.0 Release Notes

Stable v1.4.0 consolidates every change since v1.3.33. EulerStream is now the only TikTok LIVE connector; TikFinity and the Data Source Manager were removed.

- CHANGED: Stream Assistant capabilities now live in AnimazingPal; the standalone Sidekick plugin was removed
- NEW: Stream Monsters 1.1.2 retains the streamalchemy plugin ID and adds elemental eggs, community monsters, quests, and three-round duels
- NEW: WebGPU Weather Control 1.0.0 ships as an independent cinematic open beta with native rendering, Flow, socket, and community HUD controls
- NEW: Music Bot adds Smart Radio, localized live feedback, persistent catalog and playlist workflows, plus !vote1 and !vote2 viewer voting
- NEW: Game Engine adds fair Round Robin turns, active-player overlay feedback, and restored default and custom game audio
- NEW: Talking Heads adds bundled local avatar assets and gift-driven avatar lotteries
- FIXED: STT Ticker, Schnorrbecher, Weather Control, Game Engine timers, Music Bot recovery, and localized plugin documentation are hardened
- IMPROVED: WebGPU Fireworks 3.1.1 includes PyroDSL shows, 3D Furry and Boykisser finales, Pride rockets, visible-envelope alignment, and safer GPU lifecycle handling
- IMPROVED: The signed Windows launcher adds startup integrity checks, dependency self-healing, and more reliable runtime-path handling
- REMOVED: Sidekick, Data Source Manager, TikFinity, legacy LIVE-source selection, and generated Talking Heads asset paths
